units.locator: Article 24.8. Submission of procedural documents by participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: Applications, motions, complaints, protests and other documents submitted through a regional portal to an executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, a commission on minors’ affairs and protection of their rights, an administrative commission, another collegial body established under a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, a state institution subordinate to an executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, a local self-government body or their officials handling the administrative offence case may be signed with a simple electronic signature unless this Code requires them to be signed with an enhanced qualified electronic signature.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 24.8 · “Applications, motions, complaints, protests and other documents…”

units.locator: Article 24.8. Submission of procedural documents by participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case
units.text: Applications, motions, complaints, protests and other documents submitted to the body or official handling an administrative offence case through the personal account of a legal entity or individual entrepreneur, or through the electronic document management systems of participants in proceedings in administrative offence cases using the unified system of interdepartmental electronic interaction, must be signed with an enhanced qualified electronic signature.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 24.8 · “Applications, motions, complaints, protests and other documents…”

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.label: Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.label: Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 1. The rulings, decisions, procedural orders, records and other procedural documents provided for by this Code shall be prepared on paper or electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, where the court, body or official handling the administrative offence case has the technical capability.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: Where a procedural document is prepared electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, an additional paper copy shall be prepared in accordance with the procedure and in the cases established by this Code and acts of the Government of the Russian Federation, the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation and the Judicial Department at the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation adopted within their powers, including upon a motion by a participant in proceedings in an administrative offence case.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 24.9 · “Where a procedural document is prepared electronically,…”

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 2. Procedural documents prepared electronically, including in the form of an electronic document signed with an enhanced qualified electronic signature, shall, where the court handling the administrative offence case has the technical capability, be sent to participants in the proceedings by the following means:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 1) through the Unified Portal, where the participant in proceedings in an administrative offence case has completed registration in the unified identification and authentication system and:
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: а) the participant has consented on the Unified Portal to those documents being sent through the Unified Portal, except in the case provided for by subpoint “б” of this point;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 1 Part 2 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: б) the participant in proceedings in an administrative offence case in respect of whom a ruling has been issued under the procedure provided for by part 3 of Article 28.6 of this Code has not opted out on the Unified Portal of those documents being sent through the Unified Portal;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 1 Part 2 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 2) through the information system designated by the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation or the Judicial Department at the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 3) by the means specified in part 1 of Article 25.15 of this Code, provided that the person has consented, in accordance with the procedure provided for by part 1 of Article 25.15 of this Code, to notices being sent by those means;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 4) through the electronic document management systems of participants in proceedings in administrative offence cases using the unified system of interdepartmental electronic interaction.
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 3. Procedural documents prepared electronically, including in the form of an electronic document signed with an enhanced qualified electronic signature, shall, where the body or official handling the administrative offence case has the technical capability, be sent to participants in the proceedings by the following means:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 1) to the personal account of a legal entity or individual entrepreneur;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 2) through the Unified Portal, where the participant in proceedings in an administrative offence case has completed registration in the unified identification and authentication system and:
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: а) the participant has consented on the Unified Portal to those documents being sent through the Unified Portal, except in the case provided for by subpoint “б” of this point;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 2 Part 3 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: б) the participant in proceedings in an administrative offence case in respect of whom a ruling has been issued under the procedure provided for by part 3 of Article 28.6 of this Code has not opted out on the Unified Portal of those documents being sent through the Unified Portal;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 2 Part 3 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 3) by the means specified in part 1 of Article 25.15 of this Code, provided that the person has consented, in accordance with the procedure provided for by part 1 of Article 25.15 of this Code, to notices being sent by those means;
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 4) through the electronic document management systems of participants in proceedings in administrative offence cases using the unified system of interdepartmental electronic interaction.
units.label: Point 4 Part 3 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 4. Procedural documents prepared electronically, including in the form of an electronic document signed with an enhanced qualified electronic signature, may be sent to participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case by the executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, commission on minors’ affairs and protection of their rights, administrative commission, other collegial body established under a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, state institution subordinate to an executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, local self-government body or their officials handling the administrative offence case, simultaneously through the Unified Portal and a regional portal, subject to the following conditions:
units.label: Part 4 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 1) the participant in proceedings in the administrative offence case has completed registration on the regional portal and has consented on that portal to those documents being sent through the regional portal;
units.label: Point 1 Part 4 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 2) the participant in proceedings in the administrative offence case has completed registration in the unified identification and authentication system and:
units.label: Point 2 Part 4 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: а) the participant has consented on the Unified Portal to those documents being sent through the Unified Portal, except in the case provided for by subpoint “б” of this point;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 2 Part 4 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: б) the participant in proceedings in an administrative offence case in respect of whom a ruling has been issued under the procedure provided for by part 3 of Article 28.6 of this Code has not opted out on the Unified Portal of those documents being sent through the Unified Portal;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 2 Part 4 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 3) the executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, commission on minors’ affairs and protection of their rights, administrative commission, other collegial body established under a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, state institution subordinate to an executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, local self-government body or their officials handling the administrative offence case have the technical capability to send those documents through the Unified Portal and a regional portal.
units.label: Point 3 Part 4 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 5. A judge’s rulings, procedural orders and decisions provided for by Articles 29.9, 30.7 and 30.17 of this Code, prepared electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, shall be sent to participants in proceedings in the administrative offence case by posting them in the prescribed manner in the information system designated by the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation or the Judicial Department at the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation no later than the day following the day they are issued, unless other time limits are established by this Code.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 6. A person shall be deemed to have received a procedural document (a copy thereof) if:
units.label: Part 6 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 1) the procedural document (a copy thereof) has been served personally against a signed receipt or sent by registered mail with acknowledgement of receipt, and the postal service provider has recorded its delivery to the addressee in the prescribed manner;
units.label: Point 1 Part 6 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 2) the addressee refused to receive the procedural document (a copy thereof), and that refusal has been recorded by the postal service provider or the judge, body or official handling the administrative offence case;
units.label: Point 2 Part 6 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 3) despite a postal notification, the addressee did not collect the procedural document (a copy thereof) sent in the prescribed manner, and the postal service provider has notified the judge, body or official that sent the document;
units.label: Point 3 Part 6 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 4) the procedural document (a copy thereof) was not delivered because the addressee was absent from the address indicated by the addressee, and the postal service provider has notified the judge, body or official that sent the document, indicating the source of that information;
units.label: Point 4 Part 6 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 5) the procedural document (a copy thereof) has been served on an authorised employee of a branch or representative office of a legal entity where the administrative offence was committed by the legal entity in the territory in which its branch or representative office operates;
units.label: Point 5 Part 6 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 6) the procedural document (a copy thereof) has been served on the legal representative of an individual, the legal representative of a legal entity, defence counsel or a representative where they participate in proceedings in the administrative offence case;
units.label: Point 6 Part 6 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 7) a judge’s rulings, procedural orders and decisions provided for by Articles 29.9, 30.7 and 30.17 of this Code have been posted in the information system designated by the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation or the Judicial Department at the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation in accordance with the procedure provided for by part 5 of this Article;
units.label: Point 7 Part 6 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 8) the procedural document has been delivered to the personal account of a legal entity or individual entrepreneur;
units.label: Point 8 Part 6 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 9) a person in respect of whom a ruling in an administrative offence case has been issued under the procedure provided for by part 3 of Article 28.6 of this Code, who has completed registration in the unified identification and authentication system and has not opted out of procedural documents being sent through the Unified Portal, has logged into the personal account on the Unified Portal within seven days from the day the procedural document was posted in that personal account;
units.label: Point 9 Part 6 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 10) the procedural document has been posted in the person’s personal account on the Unified Portal with that person’s consent to procedural documents being sent through the Unified Portal, except in the cases provided for by point 9 of this part;
units.label: Point 10 Part 6 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 11) a person who has completed registration on a regional portal and consented on that portal to procedural documents being sent through the regional portal has logged into the personal account on the regional portal within seven days from the day the procedural document was posted in that personal account;
units.label: Point 11 Part 6 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 12) the procedural document has been delivered by electronic means of communication where the person has submitted a request for notices to be sent by electronic means of communication;
units.label: Point 12 Part 6 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 13) the procedural document has been delivered through the electronic document management systems of participants in proceedings in administrative offence cases using the unified system of interdepartmental electronic interaction.
units.label: Point 13 Part 6 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 7. A procedural document (a copy thereof) shall be deemed received:
units.label: Part 7 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 1) in the cases provided for by points 1, 5 and 6 of part 6 of this Article, from the day the procedural document is served on the persons referred to in those points;
units.label: Point 1 Part 7 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 2) in the case provided for by point 2 of part 6 of this Article, from the day the judge, body or official receives notification from the postal service provider, or from the day the judge, body or official handling the administrative offence case records refusal to receive the procedural document;
units.label: Point 2 Part 7 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 3) in the cases provided for by points 3 and 4 of part 6 of this Article, from the day the judge, body or official receives notification from the postal service provider;
units.label: Point 3 Part 7 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 4) in the cases provided for by points 7 and 10 of part 6 of this Article, from the day following the day the procedural document is posted in the prescribed manner in the information system designated by the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation or the Judicial Department at the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation or in the person’s personal account on the Unified Portal;
units.label: Point 4 Part 7 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 5) in the cases provided for by points 8, 12 and 13 of part 6 of this Article, from the day following the day the procedural document is delivered;
units.label: Point 5 Part 7 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 6) in the cases provided for by points 9 and 11 of part 6 of this Article, from the day the person logs into the personal account on the Unified Portal or regional portal.
units.label: Point 6 Part 7 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 8. If a person in respect of whom a ruling in an administrative offence case has been issued under the procedure provided for by part 3 of Article 28.6 of this Code, who has completed registration in the unified identification and authentication system and has not opted out of procedural documents being sent through the Unified Portal, does not log into the personal account on the Unified Portal within seven days from the day the procedural document is posted there, and that person has not consented or has withdrawn consent to receiving procedural documents exclusively through the personal account on the Unified Portal, a copy of the procedural document prepared under part 9 of this Article shall be sent to that person in the prescribed manner by registered mail with acknowledgement of receipt.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: If a person who has completed registration on a regional portal and consented on that portal to procedural documents being sent through the regional portal does not log into the personal account on the regional portal within seven days from the day the procedural document is posted there, a copy of the procedural document prepared under part 9 of this Article shall be sent to that person in the prescribed manner by registered mail with acknowledgement of receipt.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 24.9 · “If a person who has completed registration on a regional portal…”

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 9. Where a procedural document prepared electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, must be sent by post or a copy thereof served against a signed receipt, a copy shall be made by converting the electronic document into a paper document and shall be certified in the prescribed manner.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: 10. Where a procedural document that must be signed by a participant in proceedings in an administrative offence case is prepared electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, that participant shall, no later than the next working day after receiving it, send to the body or official that sent the procedural document, in accordance with Article 24.8 of this Code, an acknowledgement of receipt referring to its identifying particulars and stating agreement or disagreement with its content.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 24.9

units.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
units.text: If a participant in proceedings in an administrative offence case receives the procedural document referred to in the first paragraph of this part and does not send the relevant acknowledgement within the prescribed period, that participant shall be deemed to have refused to sign the procedural document. The refusal by a participant in proceedings in an administrative offence case to sign a procedural document prepared electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, shall be recorded by the body or official that sent the document.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 24.9 · “If a participant in proceedings in an administrative offence…”

units.locator: Article 24.10. Requisition of materials of an administrative offence case
units.text: Article 24.10. Requisition of materials of an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 24.10

units.locator: Article 24.10. Requisition of materials of an administrative offence case
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 24.10. Requisition of materials of an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 24.10

units.locator: Article 24.10. Requisition of materials of an administrative offence case
units.text: 1. A judge handling an administrative offence case under Article 12.24 of this Code who has information that another judge, body or official is conducting proceedings against the same person in a case concerning an administrative offence under Chapter 12 of this Code arising from the same instance of unlawful action or omission, or that a ruling imposing an administrative penalty has been issued against the same person under an article (part of an article) of Chapter 12 of this Code arising from the same instance of unlawful action or omission, shall issue a procedural order requisitioning the materials of the administrative offence case under Chapter 12 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 24.10

units.locator: Article 24.10. Requisition of materials of an administrative offence case
units.text: 2. The procedural order requisitioning materials of an administrative offence case under Chapter 12 of this Code shall specify information about the person against whom the case was initiated, the article (part of an article) of this Code establishing administrative liability for the offence, the date and place where the administrative offence record was drawn up, the position, surname and initials of the person who drew it up, or the position, surname, first name and patronymic of the judge or official who issued the ruling in the administrative offence case, the addresses of that person and judge, and the date and place of consideration of the case. Other information enabling identification of the administrative offence case may also be specified.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 24.10

units.locator: Article 24.10. Requisition of materials of an administrative offence case
units.text: 3. Materials of the administrative offence case referred to in part 2 of this Article shall be sent to the judge who issued the procedural order requisitioning them no later than three days from receipt of that order.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 24.10

units.locator: Article 24.10. Requisition of materials of an administrative offence case
units.text: 4. An administrative offence case under Chapter 12 of this Code whose materials have been requisitioned in accordance with part 1 of this Article shall be considered (reviewed) by the judge who issued the procedural order requisitioning those materials.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 24.10

units.locator: Article 25.1. Person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted
units.text: Article 25.1. Person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted
units.label: Art. 25.1

units.locator: Article 25.1. Person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 25.1. Person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted
units.label: Art. 25.1

units.locator: Article 25.1. Person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted
units.text: 1. A person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted shall have the right to examine all case materials and audio and video recordings; make extracts from the materials of the administrative offence case; make copies of those materials at their own expense, including by technical means; give explanations; submit evidence, motions and challenges; use the legal assistance of defence counsel; and exercise other procedural rights under this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 25.1
